Measurement of the critical femoral condyle ratio (CCR) and the critical tibial plateau index (CTI) on the anteroposterior radiograph of the femur. The femoral condyle is delineated by a dotted line. The diameter of the femoral condyle is measured in the center to interior (c) and in the center to exterior (d). The maximal tibial plateau is delineated by a dotted line. The tibial plateau is divided into the posterior (b) and anterior (a) regions. The distance between the posterior and anterior regions is 10 cm. The diameter of the tibial plateau is measured at the center to interior (c) and in the center to exterior (d). The tibial plateau index is calculated by the formula: CTI = (d-c)/d. The critical femoral condyle ratio is calculated by the formula: CCR = c/b.

Scheme of the measurement of the total length of the femoral shaft and the femoral component. The measurement of the femoral shaft length (a1) is the distance between the tip of the femoral stem and the tip of the femoral component. The measurement of the femoral component length (b1) is the distance between the tip of the femoral stem and the tip of the femoral component. The measurement of the total length of the femoral shaft (a3) is the distance between the tip of the femoral stem and the tip of the femoral component. The measurement of the femoral component length (b3) is the distance between the tip of the femoral stem and the tip of the femoral component.
